subject: pygmy seahorse
title: This Seahorse Hid So Well It Was Only Found by Accident in a Lab

scenes.text: Scientists discovered this seahorse without ever seeing it in the wild.
A diver in New Caledonia collected a pink sea fan coral for an aquarium.
Only later did someone notice two tiny seahorses clinging to it.
The pygmy seahorse is about two centimetres long, smaller than your fingertip.
Its body is covered in bumps that copy the coral's polyps, color and all. Pink on pink fans, yellow on yellow ones.
Divers had swum right past it for years. Now try to spot it.

description:
The pygmy seahorse was only discovered when a sea fan collected for the Noumea Aquarium in New Caledonia turned out to have seahorses on it.
About two centimetres long, it is covered in bumps that match the color and polyps of the sea fan it lives on.
Could you spot one on a reef?
first_comment: Up to 28 pygmy seahorses have been found living on a single sea fan. How many do you think you could spot?
